credentials.description: Gemini API key, sent in the `x-goog-api-key` header. Required unless passed in settings.
Alternative API key variable, read when `GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY` is not set.
Alternative API key variable, read when neither of the variables above is set.

notes: Gemini models through the Gemini API (Google AI Studio): text with thinking, tools and Google Search grounding, embeddings, Gemini and Imagen images, TTS speech, Veo video, files, decisions, extraction, Gemini Live realtime and batches. For Gemini on Google Cloud, use the Google Vertex AI provider.
